caption:
Most shops don't have a follow-up problem.

They have a missing contract.

Four clauses turn "we follow up fast" into a system your team can't ignore:
1. Clock Clause: name the minute, not the hour
2. Channel Clause: text before call
3. Content Clause: every first message earns a reply
4. Escalation Clause: a backup owner if the first one misses it

Write these four lines down this week. Post them where your team answers leads.

Want it built into your CRM so it runs on its own?
DM SCALE

#ServiceBusiness #LeadFollowUp #CRM #SmallBusinessGrowth #HomeServices
rationale: Carousels lead 2026 saves/depth for B2B authority content, and this ships an unclaimed four-clause 'contract' framework for the first response itself, distinct from every prior stage, ladder, ownership, aging-bucket, matrix, segmentation, and cadence-ritual model already covered.
